neighbours.label: repeating or echoing someone's words back ('ask them to repeat', 'repeated it after her', 'reflect back')
fire: After giving directions, the nurse asked the patient to repeat them back to her.
The coach shouted the play and the team repeated it in unison.
A good listener will reflect back what the other person has said.
Ask your child to repeat the phone number after you until it sticks.
The recruits had to repeat every order word for word to the sergeant.
In language class we listened to each phrase and repeated it aloud.
The therapist simply repeated the client's last words to show she understood.
My grandfather made us repeat the old rhyme after him every night.
quiet: After giving directions, the nurse asked the patient to sign the form.
The coach drew the play on the board and the team studied it quietly.
A good listener will wait until the other person has finished.
Ask your child to write the phone number on a card for the fridge.
The recruits had to march every morning before the sergeant arrived.
In chemistry class we ran the experiment twice to check the result.
The therapist wrote a few notes while the client described her week.
My grandfather made us wash the dishes after supper every night.
